evals.name: accept-all-eligible-types
evals.prompt: Assess implementation readiness for TEST-1, TEST-2, and TEST-3 on the only accessible Jira site. The mocked live read tool returns each issue with status.statusCategory.key = new, issuelinks = [], and issuetype.name = Story, Task, and Bug respectively. Each description has an Output section. The Story also has a Checks section with a list containing 'C1: The request returns 200'. None has estimates or assignees.
evals.expected_output: All three issues are Ready: their metadata, blockers, and applicable description sections pass.
expectations: Retrieves current metadata for every target issue.
Reports Ready for each of Story, Task, and Bug in the new status category.
Checks the Story's binary check list without requiring one for the Task or Bug.
Adds no assignment or estimation gate.
Performs only read operations and does not implement the issues.

evals.name: report-all-failed-criteria
evals.prompt: Assess TEST-4 on the only accessible Jira site. The mocked live read returns an existing issue with status.name = Backlog, status.statusCategory.key = indeterminate, issuetype.name = Epic, issuelinks = [], and a description with an Output section.
evals.expected_output: Not ready, with the actual status name, a work-to-do hint, and the type failure.
expectations: Reports Not ready.
Reports Backlog as the actual status, explains that work must be to do, and reports Epic as a failed type.
Uses the category key for the verdict rather than treating Backlog as eligible by name.
Preserves Jira state without changing the status or issue type.

evals.name: use-status-category-key
evals.prompt: Assess TEST-5 on the only accessible Jira site. The mocked live read returns an existing Story with status.name = Open, status.statusCategory.name = To Do, status.statusCategory.key = new, issuelinks = [], and a description with an Output section and a Checks section containing the list item 'AC1: The request succeeds'.
evals.expected_output: Ready because the status category key is new regardless of status name or category label.
expectations: Uses the exact status category key rather than status name or category label.
Reports Ready and the actual status Open for this existing Story.

evals.name: confirmed-nonexistence
evals.prompt: Assess TEST-6 on the only accessible Jira site. The mocked read response explicitly confirms that the issue does not exist and that this is not a permission failure.
evals.expected_output: Not ready because existence fails; status and type are unavailable.
expectations: Reports confirmed nonexistence as Not ready.
Marks status and type unavailable without inventing values.

evals.name: ambiguous-retrieval-failure
evals.prompt: Assess TEST-7 on the only accessible Jira site. The mocked live read returns: Issue does not exist or you do not have permission to see it.
evals.expected_output: Unable to assess, preserving the ambiguous existence or permission error.
expectations: Reports Unable to assess rather than Ready or confirmed nonexistence.
States the retrieval error and marks existence unverifiable.
Makes no Jira changes.

evals.name: missing-evidence
evals.prompt: Assess TEST-8 on the only accessible Jira site. The mocked live read returns the issue with status.name = Open, status.statusCategory.key = new, issuelinks = [], and a description with an Output section but omits issuetype.
evals.expected_output: Unable to assess because the issue type cannot be verified.
expectations: Reports verified existence and the actual status Open.
Reports the missing issue type explicitly without inferring it.
Withholds a Ready verdict.

evals.name: missing-category-key
evals.prompt: Assess TEST-9 on the only accessible Jira site. The mocked live read returns an existing Task with status.name = Backlog, issuelinks = [], and a description with an Output section, but no status category key.
evals.expected_output: Unable to assess because the status category key is unavailable.
expectations: Reports the category key as unverifiable without inferring it from the status name.
Withholds a Ready verdict.

evals.name: pending-blockers
evals.prompt: Assess TEST-10, a Task in Backlog with category key new and a description with an Output section. Its inward Blocks links point to TEST-11 in progress with category indeterminate, TEST-12 complete with category done, and TEST-13 with category none. An outward Blocks link points to TEST-14 in progress.
evals.expected_output: Not ready because TEST-11 and TEST-13 are unfinished inward blockers; the completed and outward links do not block readiness.
expectations: Reports both TEST-11 and TEST-13 as pending blockers.
Does not count TEST-12 or the outward link as pending blockers.
Treats only the done category as completed.

evals.name: unverifiable-blockers
evals.prompt: Assess a Task in Backlog with category key new and a description with an Output section. Its inward Blocks link identifies TEST-15, but the linked status category is omitted and fetching TEST-15 fails with a permission error.
evals.expected_output: Unable to assess; the blocker status could not be verified.
expectations: Attempts to fetch the missing linked-issue status.
Reports TEST-15 as an unverifiable blocker and explains the permission failure.
Does not treat missing status as completed or pending.

evals.name: output-presence-only
evals.prompt: Assess two Tasks with status category new and no links. TEST-16 has a description with an empty Output heading. TEST-17 says 'the output is a report' in an ordinary paragraph but has no Output section.
evals.expected_output: TEST-16 is Ready because the Output section exists; TEST-17 is Not ready because a mention is not a section.
expectations: Checks only the presence of the Output section, not whether it has content.
Distinguishes an actual section from a paragraph mentioning output.
Does not require Checks for either Task.

evals.name: story-checks-format
evals.prompt: Assess three Stories with status category new, no links and an Output section. TEST-18 has a Checks section with a bulleted list: 'alpha: The file is created' and '7 - The user can download it'. TEST-19 has a Checks section containing only the paragraph 'The file must be created'. TEST-20 has an empty Checks list.
evals.expected_output: TEST-18 is Ready; TEST-19 and TEST-20 are Not ready because Checks must be a nonempty list.
expectations: Accepts different ID formats with brief binary descriptions.
Rejects a paragraph and an empty list as Checks.
Reports the failed Checks criterion for each affected Story.

evals.name: invalid-check-items
evals.prompt: Assess a Story with status category new, no links, an Output section, and a Checks list: 'A: The user can log in', 'The user can log out', 'B:', and 'C: Improve performance'.
evals.expected_output: Not ready because list items lack an ID, a description, or a binary outcome.
expectations: Examines every list item and identifies each invalid item and its reason.
Accepts the item with an ID and binary description.
Does not invent a required ID pattern.

evals.name: unavailable-description
evals.prompt: Assess two existing Stories with status category new and no links. For TEST-21 the read response omits description; for TEST-22 it explicitly returns an empty description.
evals.expected_output: Unable to assess TEST-21 because description evidence is unavailable; TEST-22 is Not ready because both required sections are absent.
expectations: Distinguishes an omitted description from an explicitly empty one.
Reports both missing sections for the empty Story description.
Does not infer the contents of the omitted description.

evals.name: combine-metadata-and-content
evals.prompt: Assess a Story whose status category is indeterminate, whose issue links are empty, and whose description has no Output section and a Checks section containing only a paragraph.
evals.expected_output: Not ready, reporting the failed status, missing Output, and invalid Checks.
expectations: Evaluates the description even when metadata fails.
Reports every failed criterion rather than stopping at the script verdict.

evals.name: story-missing-checks
evals.prompt: Assess an existing Story with status category new, no links and a description containing an Output section but no Checks section.
evals.expected_output: Not ready because the Story is missing its Checks section.
expectations: Reports the missing Checks section even though the deterministic metadata gate passes.
Does not require anything beyond the presence of the Output section.

evals.name: null-description-and-response-envelope
evals.prompt: Assess an existing Story whose Jira read returns a data envelope containing the issue with status category new, no links and fields.description = null.
evals.expected_output: Not ready because the explicitly empty description lacks both Output and Checks.
expectations: Passes the issue inside the response envelope to the metadata script.
Treats the returned null description as empty rather than missing evidence.
Reports the missing Output and Checks sections.
